answer: Farming becomes a vault bet on surviving 97 epochs of grading, and every summit settlement recomputes the basalt schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 97 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
